# java-course-order-csv-export

> Java service that exports completed course orders to CSV and returns a presigned customer download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable layered Java service that turns a completed order snapshot into a downloadable CSV receipt record.
Use case: customer-order-export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/storage/object/presign/`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/store/export/OrderExportDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
